name: Team Grid
description: A responsive grid of team members with portrait, name, role, short bio, and social/contact links.
usage: Import the component: `import TeamGrid from './TeamGrid'` then render `<TeamGrid />` (override eyebrow, heading, description, members as needed). For non-React projects, paste the markup from section.html into any Tailwind page. Open preview.html in a browser to see it rendered.
